'''Viff Almay''' was a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] biographer who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Previously Viff Almay wrote a biography about [[Trade Baron]] [[Uunos Gooru]], which won her the prestigious [[Golden Pylat Award]]. Later in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], she was put into the [[Trade Federation Occupation Council]] by [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]].

Her position in the Occupation Council was [[chronicler]], meaning she was tasked with chronicling the occupation for the [[Trade Federation Occupation Council|Occupation Council]].<ref name="SWI" />

She, the rest of the council, Nute Gunray, and [[Settlement Officer/Legends|Settlement Officer]] [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]] were in the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] when [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], Captain [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]], and the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] stormed in and shot down the [[OOM-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] guarding her along with the rest of the council, forcing her and the rest of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] to surrender.

She was sent to trial on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] along with the rest of the [[Trade Federation Occupation Council]].

==Behind the scenes==
Viff Almay was first named in the [[Star Wars Insider 147]] article ''The Devious Neimoidians Revealed'' by [[Tim Veekhoven]], Kevin Beentjes, Sander De Lange, and [[Leland Chee]].
